build_XCiT_backbone: build a XCiT backbone model with cross-covariance attention for image classification
create_XCA_attention: create a Cross-Covariance Attention module that computes attention via channel-wise cross-covariance matrix
create_ClassAttention: create a Class Attention module that computes attention only from the cls token to all tokens
create_LPI_module: create a Local Patch Interaction module using separable 3x3 convolutions for spatial token communication
create_PositionalEncodingFourier: create a Fourier-based positional encoding module that generates sinusoidal position embeddings for image patches
